title: Oceancraft - Seafaring & Tech
description: A big ocean modpack centered around Create and the Ocean.
body:
Step into the ultimate modern setup for the Minecraft Mariner. This is a WIP polished modpack centered around massively improving the Ocean and other areas of Minecraft, tailored to many of what I am looking for in a modpack.

I have always loved Ocean games, and Minecraft's Oceans have always been boring. Over the years many mods have come out but with all the different versions/modloaders, making a polished megapack for overhauling the ocean has not been quite feasible. This uses as many compatible Ocean mods from Neoforge and Fabric as possible, and includes quite a lot of other beloved mods as well. The pack is focused around compatitability, vanilla-friendliness, and comforts. I have been a gamer for many years and know what I want in a pack, I will be tailoring it to those details. I will eventually be working on a wiki for this. If I ever have help I am hoping to make this one of the goto modern Ocean packs. For now, it's just for my friends and anyone who is interested.
